== Notes ==
* There is a 3 second delay between dropping the ashes and resurrection.
* If you are holding this when you die, you drop it and are resurrected.
* Your team will [[wipe]] in PvE and still lose an [[annihilation]] round even if your last remaining party member is holding the ashes after being killed.
* This skill cannot be cast while under effect of [[Frozen Soil]]. The ashes, however, will successfully resurrect party members if dropped while in range of a Frozen Soil spirit.
** Combine with Frozen Soil to prevent enemy resurrection while enabling it for your own party.
* This skill has a distinctive caster aura at the end of casting and a distinctive urn graphic.
